description: Greenfield or major-expansion specialty chemicals facility with reactor trains, separation, utilities, and tank farm. Process safety (PSM/RMP), licensor IP integration, and commissioning sequencing govern delivery.

typical_risks.description_template: Process licensor controls reactor internals and catalyst loading procedures; schedule depends on their field reps.
State air construction permit and RMP review may not align with mechanical completion.
Brownfield site has historic contamination requiring management plan during excavation.
Coded pipe fitters and instrument techs constrained by Gulf Coast turnaround season.
Plant location in hurricane zone risks tank-farm and structural module stand-down during season.
Owner pivots product mix mid-FEED, forcing reactor and feed-system redesign.
Process Hazard Analysis closure items pile up at commissioning, blocking startup.
Catalyst lot from {oem} requires specialised handling and arrives near loading window.

typical_issues.description_template: Modular skid alignment discrepancies required field rework at tie-in.
Reactor feed line failed hydrotest, requiring weld repair and re-PWHT.
Contaminated soil encountered required offsite disposal.
PSI/PHA action item closures slipped, deferring readiness review.
Loop checks revealed wiring errors in {n_loops} loops.
Tropical storm forced site standdown and module securing.
Late design change required Title V permit modification.
Initial product runs off-spec; tuning extended commissioning.
Pre-startup safety review identified gaps in MOC documentation.

typical_co_drivers: Module rework following dimensional control issues
Acceleration to meet customer first-product commitment
